Vivian Osei  
📍 Berlin, Germany | 📧 vivian.osei@healthtrack.innovations | 🌐 linkedin.com/in/vivianosei | 🧠 github.com/vivianosei  

**Professional Experience**  
*Senior Backend Engineer*  
**HealthTrack Innovations** (2020–present)  
Led the development of a scalable microservices architecture for a HIPAA-compliant patient data analytics platform, reducing system latency by 40% through optimized PostgreSQL queries and asynchronous processing. Spearheaded AWS cost optimization initiatives, achieving a 25% reduction in monthly cloud spend by rearchitecting redundant EC2 instances and implementing spot instance strategies. Designed and maintained CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, enabling 95% automated testing coverage for critical backend services. Implemented monitoring solutions with Prometheus and Grafana, reducing incident resolution time by 30% through proactive alerting.  

*Mid-Level Backend Engineer*  
**HealthPulse Tech** (2018–2020)  
Architected a REST API for a telemedicine scheduling system, integrating with third-party EHR platforms and achieving 99.9% uptime during peak usage. Introduced test automation frameworks for Python-based backend services, decreasing regression testing cycles by 50%. Collaborated on Linux administration tasks, streamlining deployment workflows for Dockerized applications across 12 production servers.  

*Junior Backend Developer*  
**MediCare Solutions** (2016–2018)  
Contributed to the development of a health data aggregation tool, focusing on Python-based data processing pipelines and PostgreSQL schema design. Automated deployment workflows using basic shell scripting, improving deployment consistency across staging and production environments.
